verdict: Paid channels remain off; your Google listing is the only active source.
narrative: This period, all activity came from your Google Business Profile — paid advertising on Meta and Google carried zero spend, zero clicks, and zero leads for the full 28 days. Your listing generated 86 direction requests from 101 impressions, but recorded no phone calls, and that direction volume dropped 69.7% in the most recent week, an accelerating decline that needs to be reversed. Website sessions also trended softer, averaging 12 per day over the last three days versus 19 in the three days prior, with no paid traffic to offset the dip. Several setup milestones — including the paid landing pages, ad tracking connections, and payment path verification — are being completed now to clear the way for paid launch. Once those are confirmed live, paid campaigns can go active and you will have a second, scalable source of leads alongside your organic presence.
